RankingPage.title: How we rank offers
RankingPage.intro: On a product page, shop offers are ordered by fixed, public criteria, the same for every visitor and every shop.

p: Offers are ordered by total price, lowest first: the product price plus the shipping cost given by the shop.
If the shop does not give us a shipping cost, the offer is ranked by its product price and shows “shipping cost not specified”. We never guess shipping costs.
1. Offers in stock come first (then limited stock, pre-order, unknown availability, out of stock).
2. Then the shop with the higher user rating.
3. Then alphabetically by shop name.
Some shops pay us a commission if you buy after visiting them from Pretzuri (marked “Affiliate link”). Commissions do not affect the order of offers.
There are no paid positions today. If we introduce them, they will be shown separately from the ranked list and clearly marked “Promoted”, without changing the order above.
In listings and search you choose the order: relevance, price low to high or high to low, number of offers or newest products. The default order does not depend on any payment.

AffiliatePage.title: About affiliate links
AffiliatePage.intro: Pretzuri does not sell products. We help you compare online shop offers, and some links to shops are affiliate links.

p: When an offer is labelled “Affiliate link”, the link goes through an affiliate network. If you buy, the shop may pay us a commission. Your price is the same.
Commissions do not change the order of offers, the prices shown or which products we show. The order is described on the “How we rank offers” page.
Some shops send us their product list directly. Links to them carry no affiliate parameters and we earn no commission.

sections.h: What we record on a click
p: When you open an offer, we count the click (the offer, the page it came from and whether it looks like a bot). We do not store your IP address or other personal data.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This page describes what data we process when you use Pretzuri, why, how long we keep it and what rights you have.

p: The data controller is:
Account: email address, optionally a password (stored only as a hash) and optionally a display name.
Favorites: the products you save in your account.
Price alerts: the target price, the channels you chose (email and/or web push) and, for web push, the endpoint and keys of your browser subscription.
View history: products you viewed while signed in.
Merchant reviews: text and rating, pre-moderated; we keep a moderation log and the reports received (DSA).
Security logs of the authentication server.
Clicks to shops (/go): we store only the offer, the type of page the click came from and a bot flag. We do not store IP address, user id or the full user agent.
Price history contains no personal data.
Contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): the account, favorites and price alerts.
Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): security of the service and abuse prevention.
Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): web push notifications. You can withdraw it at any time in your browser settings or in your account.
Account, favorites and alerts: as long as you have the account; deleted when you delete the account.
View history: 90 days, then deleted automatically.
Clicks to shops: raw rows are deleted after 30 days; only aggregated daily totals without personal data remain.
Reviews, moderation log and reports: as long as needed for moderation and DSA obligations.
Security logs: for the limited period set by the authentication server.
We use only strictly necessary cookies: the sign-in session and your chosen language. We use no third-party analytics or tracking tools.
Our own servers, hosted in Romania (self-hosted).
The SMTP provider Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, EU), to send emails (sign-in code, price alerts).
Browser push services (Google, Mozilla, Apple), only if you enable web push notifications.
You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and the right to withdraw consent.
Account deletion and export of your data are available directly on your account page (/cont).
You have the right to lodge a complaint with the National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP): dataprivacy.ro.

TermsPage.title: Terms and conditions
TermsPage.intro: Terms of use of the Pretzuri price comparison service.

p: The service is provided by:
Pretzuri shows offers from online shops, based on feeds received from them or from affiliate networks. We do not sell products and are not a party to the contract between you and the shop.
Prices come from shop feeds and may be out of date; stock and delivery costs may change. The valid information is the one on the shop's website at the time of your order.
We may earn a commission if you buy after following an offer from Pretzuri. This does not increase your price.
These offers are marked "Link afiliat" (affiliate link) and the links carry rel="sponsored nofollow". Paid placements are marked "Promovat" (promoted).
The ranking criteria are published on the "How we rank offers" page (/cum-ordonam).
Merchant reviews are moderated before publication. Illegal, abusive or misleading content, or content revealing other people's personal data, is not accepted.
You can report a review with the report button. If a review is removed or rejected, its author receives a statement of reasons.
The reporting mechanism and statement of reasons follow the DSA notice-and-action rules.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Matching thresholds and feed import limits. The worker reads the values on its next run.
settings.d_match_auto: Title score at or above which an offer is matched automatically.
settings.d_match_review: From this score the new product is queued for review. Must be below the automatic threshold.
settings.d_mpn_min_length: Shorter codes are ignored for matching.
settings.d_feed_min_ratio: Below this ratio of the previous run, offers do not expire (partial run).
settings.d_offer_stale_hours: Offers not seen for this many hours are deactivated.
settings.thresholdNote: Changing a threshold needs precision numbers and a DECISIONS entry (product-matching skill).
